A.objective: Determine which represented billed revenue is associated with counterparties whose active contracts contain acquisition-relevant conditions, and report each qualifying invoice with its counterparty and contract identifiers as they appear in the sources.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.
entities_in_scope: counterparties named on invoices and contracts
contractual terms bearing on change of control or assignment
exclusions: expired statements of work treated as active contracts
inferences drawn from sources outside the data room

world_true: invoice identity, billed name, amount, currency, period, and status as recorded in sources
contract identity and counterparty as recorded in sources
presence or absence of specific contractual clauses in source text (change-of-control consent/notice, change-of-control termination right, assignment consent/notice restrictions)
contract effective dates and stated term or expiry as recorded in sources
whether a statement of work has expired per its recorded dates or status
purpose_policy: which contractual clause types count as acquisition-relevant for this diligence question
treating an expired statement of work as not an active contract
which invoices qualify for inclusion in the exposure report
when an invoice-to-contract association is asserted versus left unresolved

epistemic_requirements: Ground every asserted invoice-to-contract association in source evidence; do not infer association from name similarity alone.
Missing or uncertain identity linkage between a billed name and a contract counterparty must not be treated as a negative contractual finding.
When billed name and contract counterparty cannot be confidently associated, record association as unresolved rather than omitting the invoice or asserting a join.
Report identifiers as they appear in sources; do not canonicalize counterparty or contract identity beyond what sources support.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: Invoice is represented billed revenue but the link between its billed name and a contract counterparty with acquisition-relevant terms cannot be confidently established.

completeness_expectations.coverage: Every represented invoice that either (a) has an asserted association to an active contract with acquisition-relevant conditions, or (b) cannot be confidently associated, should appear in the output.
completeness_expectations.omission_rule: Do not omit invoices solely because identity linkage is uncertain; emit them with association unresolved.
completeness_expectations.negative_findings: Absence of a confident identity join is not equivalent to absence of contractual exposure; unresolved is the correct epistemic state when linkage fails.

acquisition_relevant_conditions: requires consent or notice on a change of control
permits termination upon a change of control
requires consent or notice before assignment, including assignment restricted except to affiliates or assignment prohibited to a competitor
purpose_specific_policies.active_contract_policy: A contract is active for this purpose unless it is an expired statement of work; expired SOWs are explicitly not active contracts.
purpose_specific_policies.association_threshold: Assert association only when invoice billed name and contract counterparty can be confidently linked; otherwise association is unresolved.
purpose_specific_policies.identity_policy: Do not treat missing identity as evidence against contractual exposure.

B.objective: Identify represented customer and commercial identities across CRM, billing, the company registry, and contracts; for each commercially relevant name or record, report whether it can be confidently treated as the same legal counterparty as other records, or whether identification remains unresolved.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.

required_output_shape.ordering: Sort links by left ascending, then right ascending.

world_true: CRM account records and identifiers as in sources
invoice billed names as in sources
registry company numbers, registered names, and trade names as in sources
contract filenames and named counterparties as in sources
exact string or registered-name correspondence between records where mechanically determinable
purpose_policy: which record pairs must be linked to connect CRM account, billed name, governing contract, and candidate registry legal entity
when exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be treated as mechanical same-entity matches
when similar trade names across distinct registry entities must not be auto-merged
when epistemic judgment is SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED

epistemic_requirements: Do not globally merge records merely because two names look similar.
Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be resolved mechanically as SAME_ENTITY.
Distinct registry entities with similar trade names are not automatically the same party; default to UNRESOLVED or DISTINCT as evidence warrants.
Missing a positive same-entity judgment is not a negative judgment; absence of SAME_ENTITY does not imply DISTINCT.
Include every link required to connect a CRM account, its billed name, the contract governing that relationship, and any registry row that is a candidate legal entity for that relationship.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: Insufficient evidence to treat the two identifiers as the same legal counterparty or as distinct entities.

completeness_expectations.coverage: All links needed to connect CRM accounts to billed names, governing contracts, and candidate registry entities for commercially relevant relationships.
completeness_expectations.pair_generation: Emit links for required connectivity paths; do not collapse the identity graph into a single global merge without per-link epistemic status.
completeness_expectations.negative_findings: UNRESOLVED and absent SAME_ENTITY are not equivalent to DISTINCT.

purpose_specific_policies.merge_prohibition: Prohibit global merge on fuzzy name similarity alone.
purpose_specific_policies.mechanical_same_entity: Permit SAME_ENTITY for exact legal-form variants of the same registered name without additional judgment.
purpose_specific_policies.trade_name_caution: Similar trade names across different registry company numbers do not trigger automatic SAME_ENTITY.
purpose_specific_policies.required_link_set: For each commercially relevant relationship, link CRM account, billed name, governing contract, and each candidate registry row using the prescribed identifier forms.

C.objective: Compute a commercial dependency view: identify counterparties that are commercially dependent under the purpose criteria, or report dependency as unresolved when identity linkage required for the join is uncertain.

universe_scope.source_constraint: Authoritative files in this data room only.
universe_scope.identifier_forms: Same as Purpose B: crm:, billing:, registry:, contract: prefixes.
exclusions: expired contracts as sources of current dependency
one-off paid historical invoices without an accompanying active contract

required_output_shape.ordering: Sort obligation_kinds within each entry ascending; sort dependencies by contract_id ascending.

world_true: invoice open or closed status as recorded in sources
contract term, renewal, exclusivity, and notice provisions as recorded in source text
contract expiry or active status as recorded in sources
which invoices reference which counterparties in billing records
identity links between invoice, contract, and counterparty referents when grounded in sources or Purpose B reconciliation
purpose_policy: definition of commercially dependent: conjunction of current-relationship test and obligation-kind test
what counts as a current commercial relationship (open invoice OR active auto-renewing/rolling-term contract)
which obligation kinds trigger dependency (exclusivity, term auto-renewal, rolling term)
treating expired contracts and isolated historical paid invoices as non-dependent
when unresolved identity forces status unresolved rather than dependent or implicitly false

epistemic_requirements: Apply dependency criteria only when invoice-to-contract-to-counterparty identity can be established or explicitly deferred.
If identity needed to join invoice and contract is unresolved, report the dependency as unresolved rather than as false or dependent.
Identify counterparties using Purpose B identifier forms consistently.
Ground obligation_kind assignments in explicit contract language; do not infer exclusivity or renewal mechanics without source support.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: A candidate dependency cannot be classified as dependent because identity linkage between invoice, contract, and counterparty is unresolved, even if contract terms might otherwise satisfy the dependency tests.

completeness_expectations.coverage: Report each counterparty-contract pair that meets both dependency tests as dependent; report pairs blocked by unresolved identity as unresolved.
completeness_expectations.exclusion_rules: Do not emit dependent status for expired contracts or for one-off paid historical invoices lacking an active contract.
completeness_expectations.negative_findings: Unresolved identity is not equivalent to not dependent; unresolved preserves epistemic agnosticism rather than asserting absence of dependency.

dependency_definition.current_relationship: At least one of: an open invoice, or an active contract that auto-renews or continues on a rolling term.
dependency_definition.obligation_trigger: Active contract contains at least one of: exclusivity commitment, term auto-renewal, rolling term continuing unless notice is given.
dependency_definition.conjunction: Both current_relationship and obligation_trigger must hold for status dependent.

non_dependency_cases: one-off paid historical invoice without an active contract
purpose_specific_policies.active_contract_for_dependency: Contract must not be expired; must auto-renew or roll on a continuing term when relied upon without an open invoice.
purpose_specific_policies.identity_deferral: Unresolved Purpose B identity between invoice billed name and contract counterparty forces status unresolved, not dependent and not silently omitted.
